application.purpose: Convert one local file with a deterministic custom byte transformation and provide the result for download.

logic.instruction: Start a monotonic 5,000 millisecond deadline when this function is called.
If fileName is empty or bytes contains more than 1,048,576 bytes, output null and stop.
Run the conversion as custom application code with no network, filesystem, subprocess, or third-party package dependency.

Visit the input bytes once in their original order; replace each byte from 0x41 through 0x5A with 0x41 + ((byte - 0x41 + 13) modulo 26), replace each byte from 0x61 through 0x7A with 0x61 + ((byte - 0x61 + 13) modulo 26), and copy every other byte unchanged.
If the deadline expires or any conversion step fails, output null and stop.
Otherwise, output exactly one converted file whose fileName is the input fileName followed by .rot13, whose mediaType is application/octet-stream, and whose bytes are exactly the transformed bytes.
Accept exactly one local file and do not read or upload it before the user activates Convert.
When Convert is activated, call this function once with the selected file's original name and exact bytes.
While the call is pending, prevent another conversion and indicate that conversion is in progress.
If this function outputs null, show that conversion failed and provide no download.
If conversion succeeds, provide one download using the output fileName, mediaType, and exact bytes without further transformation.
Use / as this screen's URL path.
